entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: The short grievance of the Petitioners who claim to have lost their lands is as to non-consideration of their Representation filed under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, wherein they have sought for enhancement of the compensation on the ground that other owners of the land covered under the very same notification have got such enhancement in LAC No.202/2006.

2. Learned AGA on request having accepted notice for the Respondents although initially opposed the Petition contending that there cannot be 'pigeon-hole' consideration of claims of the kind since many factors enter the fray of decision making.

Having so contended, he now agrees to instruct his clients to look into the grievance of the Petitioners in terms of their application dated 30.11.2015,
(Annexure-C) in accordance with law and in a time bound manner.
This is appreciable.
In view of the above, this Writ Petition is disposed off.
Time for compliance is three months.
All contentions are kept open.

It is open to the answering Respondents to solicit any document /information from the side of the Petitioners for due consideration of their Application; however, in the guise of such solicitation, no delay shall be brooked.
Now, no costs.

Sd/-
